algorithm: Compute the prime factorization of n
For each prime factor p_i^m_i, compute the geometric series 1 + p_i + p_i^2 + ... + p_i^{m_i*k}
Multiply the results of the geometric series for all prime factors
Return the product as the result
constraints: n must be a positive integer <= 1000
k must be an integer in the range 0..4
If k = 0, σ_0(n) is the number of positive divisors of n
If k > 0, σ_k(n) is the sum of the k-th powers of the divisors of n
edge_cases: k = 0: σ_0(n) is the number of positive divisors of n
k = 4: σ_4(n) is the sum of the fourth powers of the divisors of n
